integrity.computation_role: Reproducibility check only; no finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.
integrity.proof_basis: Analytic reduction to centered uniform-sum moments; exact rational finite sign check for dimensions through the Cauchy-Schwarz cutoff.

scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the local first variation of the direct equally spaced splitting path.
It does not prove the reverse projection inequality in dimensions 4 through 8 and does not exclude other perturbations or a later nonlocal crossing.
title: The equally spaced reverse-projection perturbation changes sign exactly in dimension nine
